# AGENTS.md

<!-- Generated by `weft agents-md` from weft@0.1.0. Do not edit: change weft.config.ts and regenerate. -->

This is a **weft** app. It is not React: components run once, state is a box, and
React hooks don't exist. Run `weft check --json` after every change; each diagnostic gives code, location, why and fix.

Start with `.weft/map.md` (`weft map`): what this app has and what to call.

## Rules

```tsx
import { derived } from '@weft-js/core'

export function Cart({ items, taxRate }: { items: { id: string; name: string; price: number }[]; taxRate: number }) {
  const subtotal = derived(() => items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price, 0))
  const total = derived(() => subtotal.value * (1 + taxRate))
  return (
    <section>
      <ul>{items.map(item => <li key={item.id}>{item.name}</li>)}</ul>
      <p>{total.value.toFixed(2)}</p>
    </section>
  )
}
```

1. **State is a box. Read and write `.value`.** Everywhere, JSX included (W015).
2. **Anything computed from other values is `derived`.** Not in a `watch` or the component body (W001).
3. **JSX is always live.** Every `{expr}` and attribute re-evaluates when what it reads changes.
4. **Props are always current.** Destructure them (one level, W006). Read them in `derived`, `watch`, JSX or handlers.
   `const x = props.y` is a live read-only alias. `let x = props.y` and `props.y =` write locally; only `bind:y={box}`
   writes out.
5. **The component body runs once.** No early returns on state (W040), no `let` counters (W041). Branch in JSX.
6. **Pass a box only to give write access** (`value={coupon}`, child prop typed `State<string | null>`), or so list
   rows can read one entry: `cart.get(p.id)` re-runs one row, `cart[p.id]` or `cart.value[p.id]` re-runs them all
   (W017), in the list and in the row component alike.
7. **Lists and conditionals the way you know them**: `.map` with `key` (W010), `&&`, ternaries. Keep list items
   stable: replace only the item that changed (`p.id === id ? { ...p, price } : p`), never `({ ...p })` every item
   (W014).
8. **Copy a prop into state with `state.linked(() => prop)`**, not `state(prop)` (W005). `untrack(() => …)` is a
   snapshot that never updates: not for anything you render (W018).
9. **Side effects go in `watch(() => source, value => cleanup?)`**; DOM work in `onMount`. `flush()` applies pending
   DOM updates now.
10. **Async data is `resource(signal => fetch(…))`** (`.value .pending .error .refresh()`), never `derived(async …)` (W012).
    Loading and errors: `<Boundary pending={…} error={(e, retry) => …}>`. More: `weft docs async`.

**Leave props untyped**: `weft docs props`.

## API in weft@0.1.0

- `@weft-js/core`: `Boundary`, `batch`, `context`, `defineState`, `derived`, `flush`, `onCleanup`, `onMount`, `resource`, `state`, `untrack`, `watch`, `state.linked`
- `@weft-js/core/dom`: `render`, `hydrate`.
- `@weft-js/core/ssr`: `renderToString`, `renderToStringAsync`. Never import the rest.
- `@weft-js/core/browser`: `online`, `visible`, `lifecycle`, `media`, `on`, `interval`. Create them in setup (W051); server-rendered `media` needs `ssr` (W054). More: `weft docs browser`; hover and press as state: `weft docs ui-state`.
- `@weft-js/core/surface`: canvas and WebGL, never raw `<canvas>`: `weft docs surface`.
- `@weft-js/core/test`: `assertNoLeaks`, `clock`, `flush`, `memoryStorage`, `net`, `page`, `render`, `scope`, `screen`, `tabs`, `touches`, `user`, and `expect(fn).toTouchAtMost(n, { runs })`. Query by role/label/text; `user` actions and `clock.advance` end in `flush()`, so never sleep or `waitFor`.

## Diagnostics

`weft docs <code>` explains one. Also flagged: raw `addEventListener`, `setInterval` or sockets with no cleanup (W050), and a `watch` that folds a stream (W052) or copies a live value into `state` (W056).

Test checks (`weft check` on test files): T001–T009, T013. No assertion, tautologies, sleeps, `container`/selectors/test ids, mocking weft, snapshots, conditional `expect`, `.only`/`.skip`. To allow one: `// weft-allow T00x: <reason>`.

Before a change is done, see it work (`weft browser snapshot|act|assert`, or `__weft__.agent` in your own browser) and run `weft test --gate`: new tests must fail on the old code and kill a mutant (T010, T011, T020). More: `weft docs verify`.

## Full stack

`@weft-js/start` app: file routes in `src/routes` (`_layout.tsx`, `[id].tsx`, `load`, `meta`), server functions in `src/server/**` or `*.server.ts`. Read `weft docs start` first. Import your own code as `#/server/todos` (`src/server/todos`); generated files are `weft:slot/<id>` and `weft:tokens/<name>`.

- **Reads:** `query({ tags: ['todos'], auth: 'user', run: ({ ctx }) => ctx.db.select().from(todos) })`. In a component `todos().value ?? []`; in `load` and handlers `await todos.fetch()`.
- **Writes:** `mutation({ input, auth: 'user', invalidates: ['todos'], optimistic, run })`.
- **Database:** Drizzle; `await` every statement. Schema change: `weft db generate` (Q015). Inputs: `schemas.todos.insert.pick({ title: true })`.
- **Auth:** `ctx.user` is the user or `null`; `auth: 'user'` refuses anyone else (A002). A guard is `redirect('/login')` in a layout's `load`. `run` must still check who owns a row.
- **Never** copy query results into `state`, import `db` from a component (Q012), `fetch` `/_weft/*`, or poll (`todos.live()`; rooms: `channel`).
- **Every page sets `meta` as you build it**, from `data` and `params`: `weft docs meta`.

## Styling

**Run `weft style find <what it is>` first**, then reuse a group or add an axis value; never class lists. New: `const card = group('card', { base: { pad: 'group' }, axes: { status: { late: { tone: 'critical' } } } })` from `@weft-js/core/style`, `<li {...card({ status })}>`. Tokens only. D001–D007, D011, D020–D025, D030–D040, W060: `weft docs style`, `weft docs design`; `weft fix` applies the safe fixes.

## Commands

| Command | Does | Side effects |
|---|---|---|
| `weft check --json` | Compile every component in check mode and report W- and P-diagnostics with fixes | none |
| `weft docs <topic>` | Print a docs topic or a diagnostic code (`weft docs W014`) | none |
| `weft map` | Write `.weft/map.md`: a matrix of what to call in this app | fs:.weft/map.* |
| `weft add` | Install a plugin and wire it into the config (`--dry-run` shows the changes) | fs:weft.config.*, fs:package.json, network:install |
| `weft dev` | Dev server | network:listen |
| `weft build` | Production build and contract | fs:.output/** |
| `weft db` | `generate`: new migrations | fs:drizzle/**, fs:migrations/**, fs:prisma/** |
| `weft test` | The test gate on the diff (`--gate`) | fs:.weft/gate |
| `weft fix` | Apply the safe autofixes from `weft check` | fs:scope.write |
| `weft browser` | Drive the running app in any open browser by role/label/text (`weft browser help`) | network:dev-server, fs:.weft/browser |
| `weft run` | Run a project task by name | task |
| `weft run content` | Generate docs, search indexes, llms.txt and numbers from the repo | fs |

`weft tasks --json` lists the rest.

## Plugins

### Fonts (@weft-js/text)

- Declare fonts once in `text({ fonts })` in weft.config.ts: `{ body: { family, src, fallback } }`. Never hand-write `@font-face` (X020).
- The build subsets each face by `unicode-range`, adds a metric-matched `"<Family> Fallback"` face and preloads `body` and `display`. `@weft-js/core/vite` loads them: no import. `weft docs fonts`.
- A build trims faces on its own: custom axes the source never varies are pinned, and uncommon latin characters load on demand. An axis set at runtime needs declaring in `axes`; `trim: false` turns it all off.
- `text.measure` is lazy: it costs nothing until something measures, a canvas `s.text()`, `measure()`, `lines()` or `fit()` from @weft-js/core/text, or a warp list given `text` (`measure: 'off'` removes it).
- Font stacks name the fallback second: `font-family: "Inter", "Inter Fallback", sans-serif`. `font-display` is `swap` or `optional`, never `block` (X021).

### warp (UI kit)

Import components from `@weft-js/warp`; each brings its own CSS (the spec's, split per component). Layout: `Stack Row Grid Split Center Cover Frame Spacer Inset` (`gap`: hair tight related group section page; `as`: the element). Text: `Heading` (`level`, `role`), `Text` (`role`, `tone`, `subtle`). No raw values (D001–D007). Intent props only: `tone` (neutral accent positive caution critical info), `emphasis` (solid soft outline ghost frame link), `size` (sm md lg). No style props: the look comes from the dials, `data-expression="quiet|balanced|vivid"`, `data-theme`, `data-density`, `data-motion`, `data-flair` on any element (scopes nest; `setDial()` from `@weft-js/warp-core` writes them). Fields take `label` (required), `hint`, `error`, native `value`/`onInput`; `variant="classic"` puts the label above. `Modal`/`Drawer` take `open` as a box. App-wide look: `warp({ seed: { accent: '#0a7d4f' }, dials, radius, fonts, tokens })`; `weft check` fails with D010 if any pair can't pass.

### Icons

Import icons from `@weft-js/warp-icons`: `CheckIcon` is hollow, the default, `CheckIconSolid` the other form (`<Icon name="check" solid />`); `<Icons.Check />` and warp's `<Icon name="check" />` build to the same bytes. Tiers are a prop, `tier`, or the page's `data-expression`. Decorative by default; `label` gives one a name. An unknown literal name is I001 at the build and in `weft check`. A name only known at runtime is legal and loads the pack lazily (I002 reports it), or single files with `icons({ source })` and `weft icons publish <dir>`. `trash`, `bell`, `check`, `refresh` and `copy` animate with `action`. `weft docs icons` has the rest.
